sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
A stone found on an altar deep within the village of the water-dwellers. Stones will sometimes appear in the bodies of those who have long drank from the Fountainhead Waters. "Step into the marital shrine and offer the fragrant, auspicious stone."
One of the incense ingredients sought by the Divine Heir for Immortal Severance.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Give to Kuro as an ingredient needed to reach the Divine Realm.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Retrieving this item, the Lotus of the Palace and the Mortal Blade will trigger the first invasion of Ashina Castle by the Central Forces, which in turn will make all the Sculptor's Idols of the area unavailable, except for that of the Abandoned Dungeon Entrance.
